newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sallie Mae EPS view upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sallie Mae EPS view upped.

text.p: Furman Selz said Monday it raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on Student Loan Marketing Association.
-- Kept target price at $160 per share, stock remains on recommended list.
-- Raised 1997 estimate to $8.60 per share from $8.40.
-- Raised 1998 estimate to $9.60 per share from $9.40.

-- Said 1998 estimate "may well prove conservative, given it would constitute about a 14 percent gain over 1997 expectation at a time when management is targeting minimum 15 percent annual sustainable EPS growth..."
